items.title: Russia claims 1,246 Ukrainian drones intercepted overnight
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry reported intercepting 1,246 Ukrainian drones overnight. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin separately reported a large-scale drone attack targeting the Moscow region. The figures have not been independently verified.

items.title: Russia reports renewed strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck energy and fuel infrastructure that it claimed supported Ukrainian military operations. It also reported striking a cargo vessel allegedly carrying military supplies. The claims have not been independently verified.
